The Browser section now describes sampled chat frames, start-pinned human Task publication and shared Browser admission; other module responsibilities are unchanged. The runtime delta wires the Browser artifacts recorder, its Task preparation and a shared recording limiter; unrelated runtime routes and operator sign-in are unchanged. Browser recording routes enforce current person and view standing, keep frame reads bounded, and pass a Task-session selector through server authorization; a selector is not authority. Browser service composes the human recorder with the runtime limiter and disposes it before live surfaces; profile and host authority remain unchanged. The pane client carries the frame and Task-publication requests, while server routes own admission and Task identity checks. The guide distinguishes person recording and Task publication from the bound-Agent path. Reviewed this document at the affected claim and routing scope; historical or proposed material retains its status. Focused tests passed; desktop and released-product behavior remain unverified.
